integrity: Analytical global minimax proof; symbolic rational witness and finite, deterministic numerical corroboration; no claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic; three independent real unit-normal rows with positive correlations c,c,d satisfying 0<d<1 and 0<c<sqrt((1+d)/2); unconstrained positive weight scaling; worst-case Euclidean error contraction only. Full bodies of some older matrix scaling papers were not accessible, leaving historical overlap risk.
title: A sharp three-hyperplane weight transition for Cimmino reflections
